subject: Request: Immediate SOC 2 Type II evidence + bridge letter to meet audit window
messages:
From: Matt Lang <matt.lang@healthfinex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@healthfinex.com
Date: 2027-02-27T14:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — audit window closing 3/2

Ben —

Quick one: our auditors just notified us that the HealthFinex audit window for Q1 is 3/2–3/5. They still need either a current SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood or an interim bridge letter covering the period 10/1/26–2/28/27 certifying controls while a final report is in progress. This is a hard procurement gating item — without it we cannot close the integration or sign the contract.

Can you confirm whether you can provide a bridge letter and a minimal evidence packet (attestation + access log sample + control owner contact) by EOD 2/28? If not, what’s the fastest path?

—Matt
Matt Lang
Lead Procurement, HealthFinex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Matt Lang <matt.lang@healthfinex.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-27T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — audit window closing 3/2

Matt —

Thanks for the flag — we should be able to get you a bridge letter + minimal evidence, but I need to escalate internally to hit that timeline. Looping in Rishi from Security and Marissa (sales lead) to coordinate.

Immediate asks:
- Rishi: can Security produce a signed bridge letter and a 30-day access log extract by EOD 2/28?
- Marissa: I may need an approval path for a short-term credit or temporary SLA addendum if auditors push for service continuity language.
- Matt: can you confirm the auditor contact and the exact evidence list they will accept (attestation, logs, control contact)? If you can share the auditor email I’ll send a direct note.

We’ll treat this as a P1 and run a short evidence sprint. I’ve attached the SOC2_Request_Form_Fillable.pdf to capture any gaps.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2_Request_Form_Fillable.pdf

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — audit window closing 3/2

Ben / team —

We can produce a bridge letter but need to scope what HealthFinex will accept. Typical deliverables we can turn around in 24–36 hours:
- Bridge letter (signed by InfoSec lead) asserting control coverage for 10/1/26–2/28/27 (we can use the attached Bridge_Letter_Draft_v1.docx as a starting point)
- 30-day access log extract and a short summary of log retention/config (sample attached: Access_Log_Sample.csv)
- Control owner contact list for key controls (user provisioning, incident response, encryption, logging) — I’ll assemble contacts by EOD.

Constraints / notes:
- We do not have a finalized Type II report covering through 2/28/27; the Type II engagement is in progress and expected to close mid-March. The bridge letter must be explicit about that timeline and scope.
- Legal may want to review language that could be interpreted as an attestation. Looping Lauren to help with sign-off.

Proposed timeline:
- 2/27 18:00Z: Draft bridge letter + evidence package sent internally for legal/security review
- 2/28 10:00Z: Finalized package sent to HealthFinex

I’ll own the draft. Ben — please confirm if HealthFinex requires notarization or DocuSign sign-off.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
